shades.name: Jet Black
shades.note: True black with a blue-cool shine. Best on very dark natural hair that has been dyed.

shades.name: Off Black
shades.note: Our most-matched shade. Soft black with a hint of brown that blends with most natural hair.

shades.name: Darkest Brown
shades.note: Reads black indoors and espresso in daylight.

shades.name: Chocolate
shades.note: Warm medium brown. A good middle ground if you are between shades.

shades.name: Chestnut
shades.note: Brown with red undertones that come alive in the sun.

shades.name: Auburn
shades.note: Copper-brown. Pairs well with a 1B root for a lived-in look.

shades.name: Copper
shades.note: Bright ginger copper. Pre-lifted, so it will not go brassy.

shades.name: Honey Blonde
shades.note: Golden honey. Our most requested colour on units.

shades.name: Platinum
shades.note: Lifted blank canvas. Tone it to any pastel or wear it icy.

shades.name: Burgundy
shades.note: Deep wine. Looks near-black until the light catches it.
